summary: When {member} sits out one side of the coin, the best possible score changes for that side alone.
realLife: Heidi Wastweet abstained on the front of the Eliza Johnson issue, reducing the available points for those designs from twenty-four to twenty-one.
gates: The committee scores each face separately and has recorded who participated.
inGame: needs: eligible scorers and abstentions by face.

turns.what: A member returns for the other face.
turns.pulledBy: The abstention applied to one portrait alone.
turns.writesBack: The second tally restores the full possible score.

turns.what: A second member also sits out.
turns.pulledBy: Another abstention is recorded before scoring.
turns.writesBack: The chair announces a new maximum.
